prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Try moving, summoning, or hiding your new pet right here before finishing setup.", "Test Companion", "Got It!"]
1: ["Sign In & Sync Your Companion Account", "Log in to safely restore your saved pets, progress, and settings.", "Cloud Sync Active", "Continue with Account"]
2: ["Shape Your Pet's Personality", "Select traits and preview how your pet behaves live on screen.", "Select Personality Trait", "Live Reaction"]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Spawn", "Your companion is currently rendering textures and setting up desktop permissions.", "Rendering Pet Canvas...", "Assembly Preview"]
4: ["Don't worry! You can switch companion paths anytime in settings later."]
5: ["Signing in ensures your pets and customizations are automatically synced across devices."]
6: ["Upload Companion Reference Photo", "Use a clear photo for optimal 3D desktop pet rendering.", "Upload Photo", "Quality Preview"]
7: ["Play Chime When Ready"]
8: ["Your Companion is Live on Your Desktop!", "Click on your pet at any time to feed, interact, or open settings.", "Shortcut: Alt + Pet Click to Hide"]
9: ["Includes Free Starter Item Set!"]
